title: Equivalent skills, specific technologies and aliases
purpose: Five JD skills are satisfied through an accepted alternative (GCP for an AWS/GCP/Azure requirement), a more specific technology (PostgreSQL for SQL databases) or an acronym and its expansion (NLP). Two true gaps remain. Tests that equivalents are not flagged and that alias matching works.
length_note: Measured at 768 characters; chunk placement unverified.

inputs.job_description:
NLP Data Scientist - Verdant Labs (synthetic)

Required:
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Experience with a major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
- Experience with SQL databases for analysis and reporting.
- Practical NLP experience, such as text classification.
- Experience with Docker for reproducible environments.
- Experience processing big data with Apache Spark.

Preferred:
- Experience building dashboards in Tableau.

SYNTHETIC CANDIDATE FIVE
Data Scientist

SKILLS
Python, natural language processing, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Platform, Docker
